explain.what: A new comment line is a line of code: a declaration, a call, a return, an if, a lone }.
explain.why: Commented-out code does not run and is not tested. Readers cannot tell if it is a plan, a left-over or a bug. Git already keeps the old version.
explain.fix: Delete it. If it explains something, write the explanation in words.
